source.title: Ulster Herald, 21 September 1946, p. 5 ("Tyrone-Fermanagh bodies divided: L.C. elections")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the members of the new Rural Council read in the Ulster Herald of 21 September 1946, p. 5.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. There were no contests: the 39 divisions were divided between 21 Unionists and the Nationalists, with a number of changes of person. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
